items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: the man I have to take a lesson from, I said Cantrell, he told me don't never take and tighten the drum head and untighten.

ctx.x: And I ain't never broke down on that.

And I won't show you. And I had never said before that I hadn't broke down on that. But the man I have to take a lesson from, I said Cantrell, he told me don't never take and tighten the drum head and untighten.
